translation_notes: the query has FILTER NOT EXISTS with a property path (rdfs:subClassOf+) and a FILTER: not a basic graph pattern, so `s{ }`. ?nodeclass is not projected (SELECT ?onc ?type), so initBindings={'nodeclass': o} (and the `bindings` dict) disappear: `{o}` in term position at its two occurrences, the subject of `a ?type` and the FILTER operand

opcua: is `self.opcuans`, an instance attribute, not a lexical IRI: it is interpolated, `{self.opcuans.BaseNodeClass}` in object position of the path, instead of a `@prefix` (which would freeze the namespace); initNs 'base' is unused by the query and dropped

`for (s, p, o) in g.triples((onc, None, None)): self.e.add((s, p, o))` becomes `for p, o in m{ {onc} ?p ?o }: +{ {onc} {p} {o} }(self.e)` (s is onc by construction); a blank-node onc is matched as the node, not as a variable, in m{ } (the driver has anonymous list members)

FILTER(?nodeclass != ?onc) is redundant with `unique_onc.add(o)` (the node's own triples are copied anyway): widening it to `?type != ?onc` is not detected by any fixture, by construction; widening `{o} a ?type` to a variable predicate, or dropping the NOT EXISTS, is

context: lib.utils is not importable (pyld...): context_shim.py has collection_to_list and calculate_array_dimensions VERBATIM, NGSILD, and the __init__ of Entity reduced to e / basens / opcuans; the log line names a blank node whose id differs per parse, masked by stdout_filter in the driver
optimization_notes: optimized.py: the if/else on `isinstance(obj, BNode)` becomes one conditional expression. `unique_onc = set(objects)` replaces `unique_onc.add(o)` in each iteration: collection_to_list returns a list, the set is local, and the log lines keep their order. `bindings` is inlined into `initBindings={'nodeclass': o}`. The `'base': self.basens` entry of initNs goes, because the query never uses base:. The row loop becomes `unique_onc.update(row.onc for row in result)`. The final copy loop becomes `self.e += g.triples((onc, None, None))`, because Graph.__iadd__ takes any iterable of triples. All comments stay.

optimized.ldpy, from optimized.py: RDF.nil becomes rdf:nil. The query becomes `s{ ... }(g)`, and the call suffix replaces translated.ldpy's `@graph g` line. `{o}` replaces ?nodeclass at its two places, and `{self.opcuans.BaseNodeClass}` replaces the opcua: initNs. The line `self.e += g.triples(...)` is unchanged, because translated.ldpy's `for p, o in m{ {onc} ?p ?o }: +{ {onc} {p} {o} }(self.e)` is longer than the rdflib line.

No exception to the symmetry rule: outside the RDF lines the two files are identical. The notation ratio is above 1 because the tokenizer counts the s{ } body token by token, but counts the Python query string as one token.
